login.title: Sign in
login.no_password_hint: No password is set yet. On the server run: stezhka set-password

settings.title: Settings
settings.password_changed: Password changed. Other devices are signed out.
settings.keys_help: A key lets a device upload rides without signing in (e.g. the iOS Shortcut in docs/ios-shortcut.md). It can do nothing else.
settings.key_once: Copy the key now: it is shown only once.
settings.revoke_confirm: Revoke the key “{{name}}”? Uploads with it will stop working.
settings.trash_help_one: Deleted rides stay here for {{count}} day, then they are erased together with their GPX file.
settings.trash_help_other: Deleted rides stay here for {{count}} days, then they are erased together with their GPX file.
settings.erase_confirm: Erase this ride and its GPX file now? This cannot be undone.

rides.title: Rides
rides.empty: No rides yet. Upload a GPX file, or let the server watch your OpenTracks export folder.
rides.select: Pick a ride on the left.

stats.elevation_source_gps: Elevation comes from phone GPS and is rough: terrain data has not been added to this ride.
stats.elevation_source_dem: Elevation from the Copernicus terrain model. It measures the surface, so in forests and between buildings it can read treetop or roof height.

chart.aria: Elevation and speed along the ride. Hover to see the position on the map; click to centre the map there.

map.no_basemap: The background map is not installed. On the server run: stezhka basemap

errors.no_password_set: No password is set on the server.
errors.invalid_gpx: This file is not a usable GPX track.
errors.bike_exists: A bike with this name already exists.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.password_too_short: The new password must be at least 12 characters.

weather.pending: Weather and terrain data are being added…
weather.unavailable: Weather data is not available for this ride yet.
